pol-geo-01-c2.text: Halford J. Mackinder (1919). Democratic Ideals and Reality: A Study in the Politics of Reconstruction. Constable and Company Ltd, London (scan hosted by Internet Archive).
pol-geo-01-c2.quote: Who rules East Europe commands the Heartland:
pol-geo-01-c2.claim: His often-quoted formulation runs: "Who rules East Europe commands the Heartland; who rules the Heartland commands the World-Island; who rules the World-Island commands the world."
